name: CRITICAL WARNING: Sushi Bar Spider Roll (Deep-Fried Whole Soft-Shell Crab with Chitin Shell)
whyItWorks: CLINICAL HAZARD: A whole soft-shell crab dipped in batter and deep-fried. Diners consume the entire exoskeleton, including legs and claws. Chitin is completely indigestible insoluble animal fiber; in narrowed bowels or strictures, sharp chitin fragments can collect and cause mechanical obstruction and ulcer puncture.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Strictly avoid Spider Rolls and whole soft-shell crab. Choose cooked crab meat (kanikama or lump blue crab) without shells.
